title: Voice Change — Active ↔ Passive
lede: Object সামনে আসে, subject পেছনে যায় by-এর সাথে, আর মূল verb হয় V3। বাকি সব নির্ভর করে tense-এর উপর।

objectives.d: Object আগে · be verb + V3 · subject by-এর সাথে পরে
কোন tense-এ কোন be verb — মূল ছক

rules.name: The three basic moves
rules.bn: Active → Passive করতে তিনটি কাজ: **(১)** object সামনে এনে subject বানাও, **(২)** tense অনুযায়ী **be verb + মূল verb-এর V3** বসাও, **(৩)** আগের subject-কে **by**-এর পরে বসাও (object রূপে)।
rules.formula: Object + be verb + V3 + by + Subject(object form)
rules.ex: **A:** He writes a letter. → **P:** A letter ==is written by== him.

rules.name: Pronoun বদলে যায়
rules.bn: Subject ও object স্থান বদলানোয় pronoun-ও রূপ বদলায় — **I→me, we→us, he→him, she→her, they→them, who→whom**।
rules.ex: **A:** I know him. → **P:** He is known to ==me==.

rules.name: Present Indefinite
rules.ex: **A:** They play football. → **P:** Football ==is played== by them.

rules.name: Past Indefinite
rules.ex: **A:** He wrote a letter. → **P:** A letter ==was written== by him.

rules.name: Future Indefinite
rules.ex: **A:** He will do the work. → **P:** The work ==will be done== by him.

rules.name: Continuous Tense
rules.bn: Continuous-এ **being** যোগ হয় — am/is/are **being** + V3 (Present), was/were **being** + V3 (Past)।
rules.ex: **A:** He is doing the work. → **P:** The work ==is being done== by him.
rules.note: Future Continuous ও Perfect Continuous-এর passive হয় না।

rules.name: Perfect Tense
rules.bn: Perfect-এ **been** যোগ হয় — have/has **been** + V3 (Present Perfect), had **been** + V3 (Past Perfect)।
rules.ex: **A:** He has done the work. → **P:** The work ==has been done== by him.

rules.name: Modal auxiliary থাকলে
rules.bn: **can, could, may, might, should, must, ought to** থাকলে গঠন হয় **modal + be + V3**।
rules.ex: **A:** You must do it. → **P:** It ==must be done== by you.

rules.name: Interrogative — Yes/No প্রশ্ন
rules.bn: সহায়ক verb সামনে থাকে, তারপর নতুন subject, তারপর be verb + V3।
rules.formula: Aux + object(new sub) + be verb + V3 + by + agent?
rules.ex: **A:** Did he do the work? → **P:** ==Was the work done by him?==

rules.name: Interrogative — Wh প্রশ্ন
rules.bn: Wh-word সামনেই থাকে; **who → by whom** হয়ে যায়।
rules.formula: By whom + be verb + object + V3?
rules.ex: **A:** Who broke the glass? → **P:** ==By whom was the glass broken?==

rules.name: Imperative — আদেশ / অনুরোধ
rules.bn: আদেশসূচক বাক্যের passive শুরু হয় **Let** দিয়ে; নিষেধে **Let not**।
rules.ex: **A:** Do the work. → **P:** ==Let the work be done.== / Shut the door. → ==Let the door be shut.==

rules.name: Imperative — অনুরোধ / উপদেশ
rules.bn: Please/Kindly থাকলে passive হয় **You are requested to + V1**; উপদেশে **You are advised to + V1**।
rules.formula: You are requested / advised + to + V1
rules.ex: **A:** Please help me. → **P:** ==You are requested to help me.==

rules.name: দুটি object থাকলে
rules.bn: কিছু verb-এর দুটি object থাকে (him, a book)। যেকোনো একটিকে subject করা যায়; সাধারণত **ব্যক্তিবাচক object**-কে সামনে আনা হয়।
rules.ex: **A:** He gave me a book. → **P:** ==I was given a book by him.== / A book was given to me by him.

rules.name: by-এর বদলে অন্য preposition
rules.bn: কিছু V3-এর পরে by বসে না — **known to, satisfied with, pleased with, tired of, interested in, contained in, filled with, surprised at**।
rules.formula: known to · pleased with · tired of · interested in · surprised at
rules.ex: **A:** All know him. → **P:** He is known ==to== all. (✗ by all)

rules.name: Agent বাদ দেওয়া
rules.bn: Subject যদি **people, they, someone, everybody** ইত্যাদি অনির্দিষ্ট হয়, তবে passive-এ **by + agent** বাদ দেওয়া যায়।
rules.ex: **A:** People speak English all over the world. → **P:** English ==is spoken== all over the world.

rules.name: Passive → Active
rules.bn: উল্টো করতে হলে **by**-এর পরের শব্দটিকে subject বানাও, be verb ফেলে দাও এবং V3-কে tense অনুযায়ী মূল রূপে নাও।
rules.ex: **P:** The work was done by him. → **A:** ==He did the work.==

boardQ.instruction: Change the voice of the following sentences. — নিচের বাক্যগুলোর voice পরিবর্তন করো। (5)
boardQ.text: (a) He writes a letter. (b) They are building a house. (c) She has finished the work. (d) You must obey your parents. (e) Do the sum. (f) Who broke the glass? (g) Did he help you? (h) People speak English everywhere. (i) All know him. (j) The work was done by them.

items.ans: A letter is written by him.
A house is being built by them.
The work has been finished by her.
Your parents must be obeyed by you.
Let the sum be done.
By whom was the glass broken?
Were you helped by him?
items.why: Yes/No প্রশ্ন → aux সামনে; did → were। (নিয়ম ০৯)

items.ans: English is spoken everywhere.
He is known to all.
They did the work.
items.why: Passive → Active: by-এর পরের শব্দ subject; was done → did. (নিয়ম ১৬)

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — Tense অনুযায়ী be verb
drills.intro: প্রথমে tense বলো, তারপর be verb — তারপর পুরো বাক্য।

items.ans: Cricket is played by them.
A letter was being written by him.
The work had been done by her.
The task will be completed by us.
This sum can be solved by you.
I was given a pen by him.

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — প্রশ্ন, আদেশ ও ব্যতিক্রম
drills.intro: এই সেটে গঠনই আসল — Let, By whom, এবং by ছাড়া preposition।

items.ans: Let the door be opened.
Let him not be disturbed.
items.why: নিষেধসূচক imperative → Let … not be + V3. (১১)

items.q: Please give me a glass of water.
items.ans: You are requested to give me a glass of water.
items.why: অনুরোধ → You are requested to + V1. (১২)

items.ans: By whom was this poem written?
I was pleased with the news.
Books are contained in the box.

extras.title: Tense → Passive form — মূল ছক

rows: @A letter is being written by him.
@A letter has been written by him.
@A letter was being written by him.
@A letter had been written by him.
@A letter will be written by him.
He will have written a letter.
@A letter will have been written by him.
@A letter must be written by him.

extras.note: **সূত্র:** Continuous-এ **being**, Perfect-এ **been**, Modal-এ **be** — বাকিটা be verb + V3। Future Continuous ও Perfect Continuous-এর passive হয় না।

extras.title: Not 'by' — other prepositions — যেখানে by বসে না

rows: The table was covered **with** a cloth.

extras.note: এই ৮টি জোড়া মুখস্থ না থাকলে ‘known by all’ লিখে ফেলা প্রায় নিশ্চিত — আর সেটিই ভুল।

tips.t: Three moves, always the same order
tips.d: Object সামনে → be verb + V3 → by + agent। এই ক্রম মনে রাখলে যেকোনো বাক্য করা যায়।
Active যে tense-এ, Passive-ও সেই tense-এই থাকবে। শুধু be verb-এর রূপ বদলায়।
**Continuous → being**, **Perfect → been**। ‘has being done’ লেখা সবচেয়ে সাধারণ ভুল।
I→me, he→him, she→her, they→them, who→whom। ‘by he’ লিখলে নম্বর কাটা।
‘Do the work’ → ‘**Let** the work be done.’ অনুরোধ হলে ‘You are requested to…’।
known **to**, pleased **with**, tired **of**, interested **in**, surprised **at** — মুখস্থ রাখা ছাড়া উপায় নেই।

recap: তিন ধাপ: object সামনে → be verb + V3 → by + agent (object রূপে)।
Continuous-এ being, Perfect-এ been, Modal-এ be বসে।
প্রশ্নে aux সামনে; who → by whom; imperative-এ Let … be + V3।
অনির্দিষ্ট subject (people/they/someone) হলে by-অংশ বাদ দেওয়া যায়।
known to, pleased with, tired of, interested in, surprised at — by বসে না।
homework: Tense → Passive ছকের ৯টি সারি খাতায় লিখে মুখস্থ করবে।
বোর্ড প্রশ্নের ১০টি বাক্য না দেখে রূপান্তর করবে।
নিজে ১০টি active বাক্য লিখে passive করবে।
